population_note: primary population = labelled dev pairs (tier) called by the caller; not-called labelled pairs are excluded and enter only the end-to-end analysis

ident_ens_mean.description: Ensembl-style identity, mean of min and max

ident_x_cov.description: local identity (max over orientations) x min coverage of the two proteins

b3_diagnostics.note: not informative: split groups are gene-connected, so no evaluation gene has training pairs (0% overlap by construction); every B3 score is the fold's training prevalence and its AP/AUROC only reflect fold-prevalence differences

selection_rule.metric: T_pf = mean over species of the mean over seed x fold test sets of [AP(model) - AP(B1)] on the same fold pairs (slparalog.eval.perfold)
selection_rule.se: SD of T_pf over the stratified group bootstrap (config/success.yaml resamples and seed)
selection_rule.pooled_metric_reported: T = species-mean of AP(model) - AP(B1) on pooled OOF scores averaged over seeds (pre-D12 definition)
selection_rule.adoption_rule: D12: per family, the guard-passing one-SE selection on T_pf is the family's dev model; it is ADOPTED only if additionally T_pf - SE(T_pf) > 0 (beats B1 by more than one SE)

end_to_end.note: caller-missed pairs scored at the minimum (one tie block) for every method, B1 included; a caller-independent direct alignment for B1 (statistics R2 item 5) is not implemented yet
